newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia savings plan attack unjustified - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Australia savings plan attack unjustified - Treasury.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans on Thursday defended the government's savings rebate plan, saying criticisms of inequity were both wrong and worrying.

Evans said the plan, announced in the 1997/98 (June 30) federal gudget on May 13, was largely being criticised because the tax rebate on savings would go to a greater proportion of high income earners than low income earners.

"Let us be clear what the criticism is actually saying: it is expressing a concern that the savings rebate will go to people who save: not to people who are well educated, or to people who pay rent, or to people who mow lawns," he said.
